CoreBarrelType: Geoprobe temporary well screen (3.5 ft) on 2-inch outer dia. Rods
DrillersFieldComments: Done to better define North Oil body extent. Considered a push-probe site. A 3.5 ft. screen was driven with the 2'' diameter MPCA geoprobe to the water table. Water was then pumped from the screened interval. Screen interval was 19.5 - 23 ft. below land surface. Used peristaltic pump to get water. Tight material - lots of fine sediment pumped up. Oil-smelling water. Slight sheen. Hydrophopic water. Surface tension not normal. Collidal iron sheen. Considered -inchOily" by B. Bekins. The edge of the North Oil Pool should be re-drawn to include this site. Screen was pulled out of hole once water was pumped and backfilled with bentonite. Also checked water at 303 - supposedly 'water' well. Similar water in this well as the water pumped from site 1309 - smelly water, slight sheen, but less then 1309. Used peristaltic pump to sample only upper most portion of the water.
